questionText: Is 'only being up 60%' a transcription artifact for 6%?
reason: The arithmetic as spoken is otherwise correct: five wins at 1% with 1:2 reward is +10%; two losses at 2% leaves +6%; two losses at 1% leaves +8%. '60%' is almost certainly '6%' mis-transcribed. Recorded rather than silently corrected - the archived text is what it is, and the underlying argument is sound.
